snippets.title: Word Frequency Counter
snippets.description: Clean punctuation, count word frequencies with collections.Counter, and print the top words.
snippets.code:
from collections import Counter

text = "Python is readable. Python is expressive, and clean Python code is easy to test."
clean_words = [w.strip(".,!?").lower() for w in text.split()]
counts = Counter(clean_words)

for word, n in counts.most_common(4):
    print(f"{word:<12} -> {n}")

snippets.title: Filtering & Transforming Records
snippets.description: Filter dictionaries and format summary strings with a list comprehension.
snippets.code:
tasks = [
    {"title": "Read docs", "mins": 15, "done": True},
    {"title": "Write tests", "mins": 25, "done": False},
    {"title": "Refactor loop", "mins": 20, "done": False},
]

remaining = [t for t in tasks if not t["done"]]
total_mins = sum(t["mins"] for t in remaining)

print("Remaining tasks:", [t["title"] for t in remaining])
print(f"Estimated time left: {total_mins} min")

snippets.title: Virtual File & JSON Round-Trip
snippets.description: Write a Python dictionary to Pyodide's virtual filesystem and read it back.
snippets.code:
import json
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("sample.json")
payload = {"language": "Python", "version": 3, "features": ["f-strings", "dataclasses"]}

path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
restored = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

print("Restored:", restored)
assert restored == payload
